definitions.gloss: by force; by brute strength; forcibly
definitions.explanation: Relying on physical strength or coercive power rather than reason, negotiation, or skill. Almost always used in the pattern {力|ちから}ずくで (by force).

examples.japanese: {力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
{力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}かれた→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I was taken away by force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}しよう→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: Even if you try to resolve problems by force, you will only provoke resistance from the other party.

notes:
Used almost exclusively in the pattern {力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (by force, using brute strength). Contrasts with ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧ (discussion) or ⟦{説得|せっとく}→説得：14219_settoku⟧ (persuasion) as a means to an end.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: by force, forcibly
- {力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to take someone by force
- {力|ちから}ずく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{押|お}しつける: to force something on someone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{強引|ごういん}→強引：04156_gouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: forcibly, pushily — often implies social pressure rather than physical force
- ⟦{無理|むり}やり→無理やり：10526_muriyari⟧: by force, against one's will — more colloquial, focuses on the lack of consent
